name: get_model_info
author: hprebar
title: Get model info
description: Overview of the open Navisworks document: title, file, document units, modified flag, the appended models (file, source file, units) and the number of root items; optionally the root item names. Call it first so later scripts use the right units. Read-only.

includeRootItems.description: Also list the display name and class of each root item (one per appended model, usually)
